notes.title: Regarding the current connection issue
notes.notes: We are currently using free-tier server. We could not have anticipated the number of visitors. As students, it is challenging for us to maintain expensive servers. When traffic surges from certain regions, our servers become overloaded, making it difficult to provide a stable service. Due to the limited server allocation, there are times when the servers are unable to respond. We are currently looking for solutions to this issue. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Apology Regarding Regional Support
notes.notes: We released a game developed with friends but failed to properly verify its functionality across different environments. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused and regret that we couldn’t meet all the expectations. Our team is mostly made up of students with limited time, so we may not be able to fulfill the request, even the smaller ones, but we’ll do our best. We’re sorry if the game isn’t supported in some countries. We will strive to indicate areas where proper support is not available in the future. Once again, we apologize.
